title: City: maps & the real world
body: The big scale, i love playing with real-world data like maps, point clouds, GPS. Turning it into something you can actually move through, be it digital twins or location based AR. The fact that this is possible is still magical to me

title: Room: games, apps & toys
body: The human scale, what people pick up and play with. Games, apps, websites, buttons and sliders. This is where I get to be rapidly prototype, from a tiny mobile game, training sim to whole UX overhaul. If it makes someone smile or learn something i did my job.

title: Chip: tools & the nerdy bits
body: The smallest scale is the one that make my work easier: tools, computer vision, AI and work nobody sees. From SDK's, synthetic data generation, npc's you can talk to, to a simple but solid backend. The stuff needed to run everything.
